title: Words at War
paragraphs: NBC wartime anthology dramatizing contemporary books about World War II, produced with Council on Books in Wartime/war-information context. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 89 dated broadcasts plus one reference intro track.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Anton M. Leader (director on 40 recordings), Jack Costello (host on 22 recordings and announcer on 18 recordings), William Meeder (organ on 20 recordings, performer on 7 recordings, composer on 3 recordings, conductor on 2 recordings, music on 2 recordings, organist on 2 recordings, and arranger on 1 recording), Morris Mamorsky (composer on 19 recordings, conductor on 18 recordings, radio adaptor on 1 recording, arranger on 1 recording, and performer on 1 recording), Joseph Losey (director on 15 recordings), Garnet Garrison (director on 10 recordings), and Gerald Holland (radio adaptor on 9 recordings and writer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include World War II, fascism and Nazism, wartime home front, military service and combat, occupation and resistance, and war aims and international affairs.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Council on Books in Wartime partnership, Office of War Information wartime context, and World War II contemporary-document adaptation.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (70 shared credited people), [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]] (68 shared credited people), [[show|the-chase|The Chase]] (49 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (47 shared credited people), and [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]] (43 shared credited people).
